frontText: Navy 64 centered on a yellow door card. Dashed cut-line border. No other printed text.

items.title: Europe
items.placementTarget: Board, over Europe. Printed meridians are 20°E (through Frankfurt) and 40°E (just west of Moscow).

cities.name: St. Petersburg
cities.graticule: Far north, east of the gulf. A 20°E label is printed in the water southwest of the disc, so the city is east of that meridian. Population 1 square is east of the disc. No rat.

cities.name: Paris
cities.graticule: Southwest of the sticker, west of the printed 20°E meridian. The population 2 square is above the disc and left of the name. No rat.

cities.name: Frankfurt
cities.graticule: The disc is centered on the printed 20°E meridian. The name starts immediately east of the disc. Population 2 square is southeast of the disc. No latitude numeral is printed. No rat.

cities.name: Moscow
cities.graticule: East, just east of the printed 40°E meridian. Population 1 square is east of the disc. No rat.

printedRoutes.notes: A black land line enters from the west edge and ends in the Paris disc (the western of the two blue inland discs). London is the starting-board city in that direction; its name is not printed here. The line does not touch Frankfurt.

mechanics.notes: St. Petersburg, Paris, and Frankfurt are blue. Moscow is black. Only St. Petersburg is a port. Paris and Frankfurt are population 2; St. Petersburg and Moscow are population 1. None are infested. No recon box and no red region line.

summary: Europe. St. Petersburg is a blue port at population 1. Paris and Frankfurt are blue, inland, population 2. Moscow is black, inland, population 1. A supply line runs from the west edge into Paris. Frankfurt's disc sits on the printed 20°E line. No infestation, recon, or red region line.
